privacy: No screenshot bytes are committed. Only SHA256 hashes and trader-confirmed semantic labels are stored.
trader_statement: I enter on 5 minute. I was only showing 1 minute because the bot was said to use 1 minute.

correction.supersedes: The earlier interpretation that the trader's real entry momentum is a 1-minute entry sequence.
correction.rule: The trader makes the entry decision from the 5-minute setup/trigger chart. Completed 1-minute bars may be used internally by the bot to reconstruct the still-forming 5-minute candle at exact historical decision clocks without hindsight. The 1-minute view is not a separate trader entry strategy and the trader is not required to switch to 1 minute to decide an entry.

semantic_label: The trader enters from the 5-minute chart when the valid setup and momentum/force are present. The supplied 1-minute screenshots were shown only to clarify the intrabar price behavior that the bot may use for causal reconstruction of a forming 5-minute candle. Internally, completed 1-minute observations can help the bot distinguish persistent directional control from giveback while preserving the trader's 5-minute decision semantics. A single temporary 1-minute burst is not itself a trader entry rule.

replay_sampling_use.purpose: Prefer more trader-representative 5-minute momentum opportunities in fidelity calibration.
replay_sampling_use.allowed: Rank or filter only by causal setup/force geometry known at the decision clock. The trader-facing decision chart remains 5 minute; 1-minute data may be used internally to reconstruct the forming 5-minute candle without hindsight.
